en.title: Texture Image Classification Using DWT AlexNet Feature Fusion and Deep Neural Networks
en.hook: Enhance texture classification accuracy for industrial inspection and medical imaging by fusing DWT with deep neural features.
key_takeaways: Combines Discrete Wavelet Transform (DWT) with AlexNet feature extraction
Improves texture recognition in industrial inspection and medical image analysis
Surpasses traditional handcrafted feature extraction limitations

zh.title: 利用DWT AlexNet特征融合与深度神经网络的纹理图像分类
zh.hook: 结合离散小波变换（DWT）与深度神经网络，全面提升工业检测与医学影像中的纹理分类精度。
key_takeaways: 将离散小波变换（DWT）与AlexNet特征进行深度融合
增强工业检测和医学图像分析中的纹理识别性能
有效克服传统手工特征提取的局限性
